newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese pound up on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese pound up on dollar.

text.p: The Lebanese pound continued its rise against the dollar in the week ended on Friday, ending three points up on the U.S. currency in interbank trading, dealers said.
The pound strengthened steadily in quiet trade to close at 1,539-1,539.5 pounds to the dollar from last week's 1,542.25-1,542.5, dealers said.
All demand for dollars was met by commercial banks, they added.
The Bank of Lebanon lowered its bid-offer intervention band during the week to 1,539-1,548 pounds per dollar from 1,539.5-1,548.
Markets were closed on Monday and Friday for the eastern Easter and May Day holidays.
